steps: Be a Justice Federal member 18+ in good standing
Refer online: log in to Digital Banking and provide your referral's name and email address
Or refer in person: give your referral your name and zip code to supply when applying
Referral establishes membership with a $5 deposit into a Share Savings or Young Savers account and opens one additional deposit or loan product
Your $25 Referral Reward is disbursed into your primary checking or savings account within 30 days
timing: Submitting the referral takes ~10 minutes active; the $25 Referral Reward is disbursed within 30 days after the friend establishes their relationship (not instant).
